capabilities: Publish notes from a sync folder as Wiki.js pages, mapping folder structure to wiki paths
Pull changed or new wiki pages into the vault
Re-check remote timestamps before every write and show a diff on drift
Convert Obsidian markdown on push (wikilinks to wiki links, callouts to blockquote classes)
Show a per-page sync status view with push, pull, adopt and discard actions
extras: Marked as an MVP: text only, no attachment sync, no automatic merge, and no pull out of conflicts yet. Listed since 2026-08-12 and not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Further documentation lives in an external docs index, including troubleshooting.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to a self-hosted Wiki.js instance or keep local notes and wiki pages in sync safely.

relations.evidence: publishes and syncs notes from one folder of your vault to a Wiki.js 2.x instance

requires.name: Wiki.js API key with page-write access

summary: Publishes and syncs notes from one vault folder to a Wiki.js 2.x wiki over GraphQL, with drift detection and manual conflict resolution.
